# Benoit Busser

I am a **Professor of Biochemistry and Cancer Sciences** at Université Grenoble Alpes and a **senior clinical biochemist** at Grenoble Alpes University Hospital. My work combines laboratory medicine, cancer research, elemental imaging and environmental and occupational health.
</div>

## A dual academic and clinical perspective

My career has developed at the interface of the university and the hospital. This dual position shapes the way I approach research: analytical technologies are most useful when they answer a clearly defined biological or clinical question, and clinical observations can in turn reveal new analytical challenges.

At Université Grenoble Alpes, I teach biochemistry, cancer sciences and laboratory medicine. At Grenoble Alpes University Hospital, I am involved in clinical biochemistry and I head the Point-of-Care Testing activity.

## Training & academic pathway

I studied pharmacy in Strasbourg before completing a hospital pharmacy residency in Grenoble. I graduated **PharmD in 2008**, defended a **PhD in Cell Biology in 2009**, was appointed **Associate Professor in Biochemistry in 2012**, obtained the **HDR (Research Supervision Diploma) in 2017**, and became **Full Professor (PU-PH) in 2023**.

::: {.research-strip}
### Academic trajectory

**2004–2009** — Pharmacy residency, Grenoble Alpes University Hospital  
**2009–2012** — Assistant Professor (AHU), Université Grenoble Alpes  
**2012–2023** — Associate Professor (MCU-PH), Université Grenoble Alpes  
**Since 2023** — Full Professor (PU-PH) of Biochemistry and Cancer Sciences
:::

## Teaching

My teaching covers **general and clinical biochemistry, cell and cancer biology, molecular biology and biotechnologies**, for pharmacy students, master's students, medical residents and other health-science audiences.

This teaching activity is closely connected to research and clinical practice, with a particular emphasis on linking analytical methods to biological interpretation and patient care.

## Metals & Health

I lead the **“Metals & Health”** research group at the Institute for Advanced Biosciences (IAB, Inserm U1209 / CNRS UMR 5309 / Université Grenoble Alpes). Our work investigates how metals, mineral particles and other elemental signatures are distributed in human tissues and how they relate to exposure, disease mechanisms and clinical questions.

This programme brings together analytical chemistry, pathology, occupational and environmental medicine, respiratory medicine, cancer sciences and data analysis.

## BioLIBS and elemental pathology

I am scientific director of **BioLIBS**, a **Université Grenoble Alpes platform** dedicated to multi-element tissue imaging by laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS), with the instrument installed at **Grenoble Alpes University Hospital**. The platform develops workflows for archived and fresh biological tissues, with applications ranging from lung exposure and inflammatory diseases to cancer and biomaterials.

A central objective is to help establish **elemental pathology** as a translational field: moving from chemical maps of tissues toward interpretable information that can complement conventional pathology and clinical data.

## Cancer sciences and translational imaging

My research also includes tumor biology, molecular imaging, nanomedicine and theranostic strategies. Earlier work focused particularly on cancer signalling, mechanisms of resistance to targeted therapies, molecular diagnostics in solid tumours and innovative therapeutic approaches.

These projects share the same translational logic: combine mechanistic biology with robust analytical methods and clinically meaningful endpoints.

## Clinical background

My hospital career has included activities in general clinical biochemistry, cancer biomarkers, molecular genetics and molecular diagnostics. I led the **Clinical Cancer and Biotherapies laboratory from 2013 to 2016**, then worked as a senior clinical biochemist in molecular genetics before taking responsibility for **Point-of-Care Testing in 2023**.

## Training and scientific community

I supervise doctoral, postdoctoral and master's-level researchers and collaborate with teams in analytical chemistry, biology, medicine, physics and engineering. I am also a Junior Fellow of the **Institut Universitaire de France**.
